title: Board
intro: Your company's shared cards. Everyone on this desk sees a change the moment it is made.
loadFailed: The board could not be loaded.

detail.title: Title
detail.archiveConfirm: Archive this card? It leaves the board for everyone on this desk.
detail.changedElsewhere: Someone else just changed this card. What you see is their version.

live.paused: Paused: this board is open in too many of your tabs.
live.ended: Your access to this board ended. Reload the page to sign in again.

errors.card_conflict: Someone changed this card while you were editing. Their version is shown now and your edits are still in the boxes. Save again to keep yours.
errors.moveConflict: Someone changed this card just before you moved it. The board has been reloaded; move it again if you still want to.
errors.card_not_found: This card is gone. Someone may have archived it.
errors.column_not_found: That column is gone. The board has been reloaded.
errors.admin_only: Only an owner or admin can change the columns.
errors.builtin_column: The built-in columns stay on the board.
errors.column_not_empty: Move or archive this column's cards first.
errors.invalid_card: That change was not accepted. Check the title and try again.
errors.invalid_column: A column needs a name of up to 60 characters.
errors.not_allowed: Only the card's creator, its assignee, or an owner or admin can archive it.
errors.card_limit: This board holds 5,000 cards. Archive some before adding more.
errors.comment_limit: This card holds 500 comments. Start a new card to keep talking.
errors.column_limit: This board holds 50 columns. Remove one before adding another.
errors.position_exhausted: The card could not be placed there. Reload the board and try again.
errors.generic: The board could not be updated. Try again.
